mods.name: BedwarsResourceHud
mods.description: Displays Bedwars resource counts (inventory, ender chest, total) in a repositionable HUD.

releases.notes:
## What's fixed

- Bed alarm no longer fires on your own party members. The scoreboard team-color check resyncs whenever a player's entity is re-added client-side - which happens when someone reconnects mid-match - and during that window they could briefly read as an intruder standing next to your own bed. Added a name-based party tracker (fed from Hypixel's own party join/leave messages) as a fallback teammate signal, used by the bed alarm, threat radar, and enemy highlighting alike.
- The update notification toast is now clickable - clicking it opens the release page instead of only being visible in chat or the config screen.
- Minor: the update checker now closes its HTTP client explicitly after each check.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- Fabric API 0.155.2+26.2
- Java 25
- Mod Menu 20.0.1+ (optional, for the config screen)

releases.notes:
## What's fixed

- Bed ESP no longer shows two markers per bed (was tracking both bed halves separately); it now draws a real world-space box outline around the bed instead of a flat dot.
- Bed alarm no longer triggers in the Bed Wars portal/practice lobby - it's now armed specifically by the "Protect your bed and destroy the enemy beds." match-start message instead of just detecting anything Bed Wars-related.
- Bed alarm detection is more reliable: the search area is anchored consistently instead of drifting if you move before it finds your bed, the search box is bigger (handles maps where the bed sits well above/below or further from spawn), and it falls back to your current position if the anchor comes up empty.
- The update checker now reads GitHub's release list instead of `/releases/latest`, which excludes prereleases and was always failing with a 404 given this project publishes as prerelease.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- Fabric API 0.155.2+26.2
- Java 25
- Mod Menu 20.0.1+ (optional, for the config screen)

releases.notes:
## What's new

- Generator waypoints for iron, gold, diamond, and emerald generators
- Void edge warning and fall damage warning
- Threat radar showing nearby enemy players
- All-bed ESP and a configurable bed alarm (proximity + sound alert)
- Sneak/invisibility highlighting for enemy players
- Per-item alert sounds and a dedicated custom items screen
- Automatic update checks: an in-game chat notice and a download-link button in the config screen when a new release is available

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- Fabric API 0.155.2+26.2
- Java 25
- Mod Menu 20.0.1+ (optional, for the config screen)
